subject: Strange Warning while installing mirt package

messages.author: b824e0960b1c7ab9
messages.subject: Strange Warning while installing mirt package
parts:
Hi,

I have recently update my mirt 1.19 package to it's new 1.21 version in my macbook pro 2013 with macOS Sierra version 10.12.2 (Xcode Command Line Tools 8.2) . However when I plot a confirmatory MIRT model, which seems to works in previous versions, the plot show a strange message - "Error using packet 1 negative length vectors are not allowed" (see picture below).


my code:
IRT <- mirt.model('T = 1,3,4,5,7,8,9,10,12,15,16
ST = 2,6,11,13,14
COV = TST,45,78,1314')
(IRTmodel3 <- mirt(data, IRT))
summary(IRTmodel3)
plot(IRTmodel3)

While I check the possible causes of this situation I found a strange warning in the package's compilation:
